question: Which person was/is compared with Shakespeare and is/was referred to as Shakespeare of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kalidasa**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalidasa** was a renowned classical Sanskrit poet and playwright in ancient India, whose works are celebrated for their literary excellence, vivid imagery, and emotional depth.
 
• He is often compared to **William Shakespeare** because, like Shakespeare, he made significant contributions to literature and created timeless works that depict human emotions and nature with great sensitivity.
 
• Kalidasa's famous works include **"Shakuntala" (Abhijnanashakuntalam)**, **"Meghaduta" (The Cloud Messenger)**, and **"Raghuvamsha"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• Panini: An ancient Sanskrit philologist and grammarian, known for his work on Sanskrit grammar, particularly his text "Ashtadhyayi". 
 
• Kautilya (Chanakya): An ancient Indian philosopher, economist, and advisor to Emperor Chandragupta Maurya, known for his treatise "Arthashastra" on statecraft and military strategy.
 
• Vishnu Sharma: The author traditionally attributed to the Panchatantra, a collection of animal fables,
